headline: Payton Tolle silences Blue Jays as Red Sox snap painful losing skid
morning_brew: Finally, a night at Fenway that doesn't make me want to drive my car into the Charles. Watching Payton Tolle dominate for eight innings against Toronto was exactly the medicine this team needed to shake off that miserable five-game slide. That is how you stop a sinking ship, by letting a rookie step up and show everyone how it is done, throwing absolute darts and keeping the bats quiet for a full evening.

The offense finally decided to wake up, too, giving us a cushion so I didn't have to sweat the ninth inning like I was defusing a bomb. Caleb Durbin with the grand slam was a monster moment that blew the roof off the Fens, and I haven't seen a swing like that since my cousin Jimmy tried to clear the neighbor's fence with a Wiffle ball. We have been waiting for a performance that feels this controlled from start to finish, and seeing the bullpen handle the final frame with ease was the perfect way to wrap up a much-needed win.

We head to Pittsburgh tonight with a little bit of swagger in our back pocket. The season is still a grind, but days like yesterday prove this group has enough talent to get back on track if they keep playing with that kind of focus. I am not saying we are out of the woods, but for once, I can actually grab my Dunks this morning without feeling like I need to yell at the clerk.

news_digest.dans_take: It is only the preseason, but watching our defense get gashed like that is a rough way to start the morning.

trend_watch.trend: Eight scoreless innings with four strikeouts
trend_watch.dans_take: That was a masterclass in command and poise that made me forget the last week of misery.

trend_watch.trend: Grand slam provided the offensive fireworks
trend_watch.dans_take: About damn time someone actually punished a pitch with the bases loaded.

trend_watch.trend: Called up and provided a scoreless frame
trend_watch.dans_take: Welcome to the show, kid, keep throwing strikes and you will be a local hero by Sunday.
